executive_summary.headline: What changed
executive_summary.body: From a forward-deployed AI strategist’s perspective, the week of August 24, 2026 demonstrated that enterprise AI is no longer a question of whether organizations should pay attention. The industry is inundated with AI announcements, but the reality inside most enterprises is more uneven. Organizations are moving through different stages of AI FOMO, urgency, experimentation and prioritization as they determine where AI should be extended across their software portfolio, operating model and technology architecture. ... The decision point is not simply whether an enterprise has access to AI models, copilots or agents. It is whether the organization has the context, governance, security, process
